defs.def: to pay an amount of money regularly in order to receive or use sth 定期订购（或订阅等）

ex.s: By the way, if you have enjoyed this live broadcast, subscribe to find out where I’m visiting next!
ex.t: 顺便说一句，如果你喜欢这场直播，请订阅以了解我下一站去哪里！

ex.s: Snow subscribed to the second theory.
Secondly, take advantage of opportunities for lifelong learning-for example, you could register online and subscribe to e-learning courses, which have become increasingly popular in recent years.
ex.t: 其次，要利用终身学习的机会——例如，你可以在线注册并订阅电子学习课程，近年来这些课程越来越受欢迎。

defs.def: to pay money regularly to be a member of an organization or to support a charity 定期交纳（会员费）；定期（向慈善机构）捐款；定期捐助
to apply to buy shares in a company 认购（股份）
to apply to take part in an activity, use a service, etc. 申请；预订；报名
